samples.title: Giờ làm linh hoạt
samples.prompt: Why might people support the proposal that employers should offer flexible hours when the work allows it? Is this a positive or negative development?
requirementsVi: Trả lời vì sao có người ủng hộ.
Đánh giá tích cực hay tiêu cực và giải thích.
Thừa nhận điều kiện, kết cả hai câu trả lời.
samples.summaryVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are understandable reasons why people may support the proposal that employers should offer flexible hours when the work allows it. I consider this a mainly positive development when it is organised with practical needs in mind. Its value comes from the help it can offer in daily life, rather than from the idea simply sounding modern or attractive.
paragraphs.noteVi: Trả lời ngắn cả hai câu hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 1 — vì sao?
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. This is possible because different starting times can reduce clashes between work and family responsibilities. For example, a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 2 — đánh giá
paragraphs.text: I see the development as positive because it gives people a useful option, provided that the main obstacles are recognised. One concern is that team members may not be available at the same time. This is connected with the fact that flexible schedules may be introduced without agreed shared hours. Ignoring that concern would weaken the case for the proposal, so support should include an effort to improve how it works.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đánh giá có lý do và giới hạn.

paragraphs.label: Ví dụ về điều kiện
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to set core hours and make availability clear to the team. For example, a department could agree that everyone is reachable between ten and three while allowing choice outside that period. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Minh họa cách giữ lợi ích và giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, people have good reason to support this approach because employees can organise work around practical personal needs. I regard it as mainly positive, but the result depends on practical planning. A flexible approach that listens to the people involved is more likely to deliver the intended value.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt cả lý do và đánh giá.

paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to agree on practical arrangements and allow flexibility. For example, a small group could share a timetable, decide how costs are divided and keep an alternative way to travel home. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Minh họa cách giữ lợi ích và giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, people have good reason to support this approach because employees can share travel costs and reduce the number of separate trips. I regard it as mainly positive, but the result depends on practical planning. A flexible approach that listens to the people involved is more likely to deliver the intended value.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt cả lý do và đánh giá.

samples.title: Dịch vụ khách hàng
samples.prompt: Why might people support the proposal that businesses should train staff to handle complaints clearly and respectfully? Is this a positive or negative development?
requirementsVi: Trả lời vì sao có người ủng hộ.
Đánh giá tích cực hay tiêu cực và giải thích.
Thừa nhận điều kiện, kết cả hai câu trả lời.
samples.summaryVi: Giao tiếp lịch sự cần đi cùng quy trình và quyền xử lý để khách nhận được bước tiếp cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are understandable reasons why people may support the proposal that businesses should train staff to handle complaints clearly and respectfully. I consider this a mainly positive development when it is organised with practical needs in mind. Its value comes from the help it can offer in daily life, rather than from the idea simply sounding modern or attractive.
paragraphs.noteVi: Trả lời ngắn cả hai câu hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 1 — vì sao?
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that customers can understand what can be done about a problem. This is possible because clear communication can turn a confusing situation into a series of practical steps. For example, a shop assistant can explain the return process and tell a customer when to expect a response. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giao tiếp lịch sự cần đi cùng quy trình và quyền xử lý để khách nhận được bước tiếp cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 2 — đánh giá
paragraphs.text: I see the development as positive because it gives people a useful option, provided that the main obstacles are recognised. One concern is that staff may be unable to solve problems without authority. This is connected with the fact that businesses may train communication skills without improving internal procedures. Ignoring that concern would weaken the case for the proposal, so support should include an effort to improve how it works.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đánh giá có lý do và giới hạn.

paragraphs.label: Ví dụ về điều kiện
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to give staff clear guidance and a reliable route for difficult cases. For example, a manager could provide a simple decision guide and make sure complex complaints reach the right person. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Minh họa cách giữ lợi ích và giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, people have good reason to support this approach because customers can understand what can be done about a problem. I regard it as mainly positive, but the result depends on practical planning. A flexible approach that listens to the people involved is more likely to deliver the intended value.
